Title: The Mysterious Merchant is back
Text: Cragara turns up in a different town every hour, selling things you won't find in the Shop: a Retro Hover-Car, the OSFR Foam Costume, streetwear, new hairstyles and more. Watch chat to find out where she is, and be quick: she never stays long!

Title: Join live events
Text: When a Referee hosts an event, everyone online gets the call. Type !join to go straight there from anywhere, and stick around for prizes!

Title: Rank up your jobs
Text: Defeating enemies, finishing quests and completing collections now earn stars for the job you're in. Fill the bar to rank up, all the way to rank 20: every rank gives more health and harder hits.

Title: Team up and trade
Text: Click another player to Invite to Group (up to five) or to Trade items and coins. Group members fighting together share stars, coins and loot.

Title: Loot to find
Text: Enemies drop potions, orbs and coins, and the tough ones always leave something behind. Open a Thick Pocket Book or a Robgoblin Treasure Trove to see what's inside!

Title: Quests are here!
Text: Talk to the folks with a marker over their heads to pick up quests. Track your goals in the Hero's Journal and earn rewards when you're done.

Title: Move into your own house
Text: Houses are open! Pick one out, then decorate it with furniture and make it yours.

Title: Everything costs coins
Text: Station Cash and memberships are gone. Everything in the Shop is bought with the coins you earn playing.

Title: Spin the daily wheel
Text: Find the daily wheel in the Games window and give it a spin for a prize.

Title: Potions, scrolls and treats
Text: Potions, scrolls, buff foods and illusion masks work now. Try them out and see what happens!

Title: Pets and collections
Text: Bring a pet along on your adventures, and look for sparkles in the world to fill out your collections.

Title: Got a code?
Text: Press Enter and type !redeem to open the code box, then enter your code to claim items and coins.

Title: A fresh new look
Text: A new loading screen and this new home screen, with Referee Picks and your friends who are online.
